cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It stayed in the kitchen where I can admire it privately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still beat seven cakes that had every intention of winning.

mechanism: Copy a confident entrant's withdrawal without knowing why, then disguise that reduced competition to protect a parent's pride in winning.
confusable: Not simple congratulations: B2 must reveal the withdrawal and its model, while A hides the reason by adopting that model's certainty.
comparison: Family cake prize and an offered split differ from a chess rematch proving competence.
seedUse: Retains Mum's cake win and A's withdrawn cake; introduces mistaken assumption about another entrant's withdrawal.
